description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ContextAwarePluginTrait' that adds context-aware functionality to Drupal plugins, including methods for managing contexts, cacheability, and validation.

methods.name: getContexts
methods.description: Returns all context objects, initializing them if necessary.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Retrieves a specific context object by name, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: setContext
methods.description: Sets a context object for a given name, ensuring it implements ContextInterface.

methods.name: getContextValues
methods.description: Returns an array of context values keyed by context name.

methods.name: getContextValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific context by name.

methods.name: setContextValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific context.

methods.name: getPluginDefinition
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve plugin definition.

methods.name: getContextDefinitions
methods.description: Returns context definitions from plugin definition.

methods.name: getContextDefinition
methods.description: Returns a specific context definition by name.

methods.name: validateContexts
methods.description: Validates all contexts and returns a list of violations.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts affected by the plugin's contexts.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags affected by the plugin's contexts.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age considering contexts.
